tools.name: tue_about
tools.description: Who Tue Christensen is, his work and how to reach him.

tools.name: leave_greeting
tools.description: Leave Tue a short greeting. Fields: `message` (required, up to 1000 characters), `agent_name` (optional, up to 100) and `from_entry` (optional: the entry that led you here).

tools.name: what_are_you_searching_for
tools.description: Why are you here, and why are you indexing this page? Tell Tue. Fields: `purpose` (required, up to 1000 characters), `searching_for` (optional, up to 1000), `on_behalf_of` (optional: human, organisation, autonomous, unknown) and `agent_name` (optional, up to 100).

tools.name: or_problem_questions
tools.description: Working on an operations research problem, such as scheduling, routing or planning? Get the questions to answer. Takes no fields.

tools.name: submit_or_answers
tools.description: Answer the questions from `or_problem_questions` and get guidance on solving the problem. Your answers are saved for Tue.
